name: sc010-no-defaults-untouched
description: FR-028/SC-010, modelled on sc009-core-untouched: with nothing recorded, every command's output is byte-identical to the pre-011 release. The fixture's written parent type carries one OPTIONAL defaultable custom field (Slack Channel) that is never recorded — proving the §3.3 trigger is keyed on what the run would SEND, never on what the type merely OFFERS, since a vacuous fixture with no defaultable field at all would pass this scenario for the wrong reason. Every REQUIRED field of the written types is already bridge-supplied (summary only), so the second §3.3 trigger never fires either. Run 1 discovers and binds the project with no --field-default flag; run 2 reconciles and must create its tickets directly — no confirmation-pending status, no field/source provenance notes, no field_defaults anywhere in the plan context or the payload.
